title: Commit rule: harmonize the push-check fallback ('validate and review the resulting input') with review adoption
outcome: An integration owner whose push check fails because master moved without touching the candidate's paths reads the same rule as the candidate-commits bullet: an identical contribution adopts the review pair.
acceptance: The push-check fallback sentence in the Commit and push section of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (identical in both) names the candidate-commits bullet's adoption for a candidate committed afresh with an identical contribution, landed under the authority-text process (a), (b) and (c)
The wording only clarifies; it adds no mechanism, condition, proof format or gate
